reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Source shows shirtless muscular bearded Big Boss with harness and headband wrapping or fighting a large thick tan snake above tangled wooden branches, knife and pistol in hand. The published nominal Big Boss cover depicts a standing uniformed soldier with boots and gear, holding pistol low and one hand near ear on a dark rocky base. The bare torso, coiled serpent, leg stance, wooden tree base and equipment differ, corroborated by six source views. The candidate mdl_bccd5cff1c3fafa4763f was separately mapped to another source sculpture (Big Boss 3, product 27486); it must not also absorb this distinct sculpt without independent verification.

mediaReview.notes: Source images feature third-party artist logo and promotional watermark. Never import, crop, publish or remove branding without independent rights and provenance verification.

decision.nextGate: Inspect other Metal Gear Big Boss historical variant covers read-only; retain previously approved identity for source 27486 and do not create a duplicate.
